app.name: Spot the Pothole
app.tagline: Name it. Confirm it. Track the fix.

map.title: Pothole map
map.empty: No potholes in this area yet. Be the first to spot one!

feed.title: Recent spots
feed.empty: Nothing new nearby. Hit Spot when you see a crater.

spot.title: Spot a pothole
spot.cameraHint: Take a live photo at the pothole (GPS required).
spot.gpsRequired: Turn on location to spot potholes.
spot.useMobileApp: Spotting needs a live camera photo with GPS. Use the Android or iOS app — the website cannot capture spots.
spot.speedTooFast: Pull over safely before spotting a pothole. Capture is disabled above 10 km/h.
spot.gpsAccuracyPoor: Waiting for a clearer GPS fix before you can take a photo.
spot.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera access is required to spot potholes. Enable it in Settings.
spot.locationPermissionDenied: Location access is required to spot potholes. Enable it in Settings.
spot.captureReady: Hold steady and tap the shutter when you are safely stopped.

upload.failed: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
upload.blurFailed: We could not blur faces or plates on this photo. Take another shot.
upload.success: Spot submitted — thanks for helping fix the roads!
upload.pendingModeration: Photo received and pending moderation before it appears publicly.
upload.nameRequired: Give the pothole a name before submitting.
upload.signInRequired: Sign in to upload your spot.

pothole.confirmHint: Stand within 15 m and confirm it is still here.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: No scores yet. Spot and confirm potholes to climb the board.

profile.title: Profile
profile.spotRequiresAuth: Sign in to spot or confirm potholes. You can still browse the map without an account.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.noFullNameHint: We only ask for email (private) and a public username during setup — never your full name.

onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.consentLead: Before we collect anything, please read how we use your data under POPIA.
onboarding.privacyNoticeBody: We store your account email privately (never shown publicly). When you spot a pothole we save the photo and GPS location to place it on the map and share with other players. We do not collect your full name. You can delete your account and data at any time in Profile.
onboarding.consentCheckbox: I agree to the privacy notice and consent to location and photo processing for spotting potholes.
onboarding.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, and underscores only. This is what others see — not your real name.
onboarding.anonymousLabel: Appear anonymous on the map and leaderboard
onboarding.anonymousHint: Your spots still help the game, but other players will not see your username.
onboarding.permissionsLead: Next, your device will ask for camera and location when you spot a pothole.
onboarding.cameraReason: Camera: live photo at the pothole (required to spot).
onboarding.locationReason: Location: GPS places the pothole on the map (required to spot).

usernameError.invalidFormat: Use 3–24 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
usernameError.looksLikeFullName: Use a nickname — not your full name.

account.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account, profile, and game history. This cannot be undone.

moderation.photoQueueHint: Draw extra blur boxes if needed, then approve or reject.
moderation.drawBlurHint: Drag on the photo to add blur boxes. Click a box to remove it.
moderation.signedUrlExpired: Preview link expired — refresh the queue.
moderation.forbidden: You do not have moderator access.

errors.duplicateNearby: A pothole was already reported nearby — merged with existing record.
